name: get_flags_project_disconnection_link
description: Get a dashboard link to disconnect a consumer from the source project’s flags across environments. projectIdOrName selects the source; consumerProjectId identifies the connection to remove. Verifies source project ownership and returns requires_user_action. The user must select Remove Connection in Vercel with connection management permission on the source. This tool does not revoke access.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
